summary: Phase 6 testing for PayPal integration + Client Portal. Ran 27 backend pytest cases (26 pass, 1 fail — critical security: client JWT can access admin endpoints because get_current_user does not enforce role). Frontend: header client-login button, /register → /portal, all 5 portal tabs, profile save+persist, logout, footer 5x-click admin gate, mobile menu client-login button, /forgot-password, and Express pricing checkout dialog (PayPal Smart Buttons iframe loads) — ALL PASS.

critical.endpoint: /api/admin/clients (and other admin routes guarded by get_current_user)
critical.issue: Role separation broken: a JWT issued for role="client" is accepted by get_current_user (auth.py L50-60). It does NOT check payload.role. Therefore a client token can call /api/admin/clients, /api/paypal/admin/*, /api/notifications, /api/admin/* etc. Test pytest test_client_token_cannot_access_admin_clients FAILED with 200 (expected 401/403). The reciprocal direction (admin token hitting /api/clients/me) IS correctly rejected (403 'Client access required') because get_current_client checks role.

minor.issue: Returns ok=false (expected) because PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET == PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID in /app/backend/.env. This is the documented user-config issue — backend handles it gracefully. No fix needed in code, but user must paste real PayPal sandbox secret.
Express tier order creation returns 502 'invalid_client' due to same root cause (bad PayPal credentials). Graceful — no crash. Will succeed once real secret is set.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent}' — accessibility nit, add DialogDescription to CheckoutDialog in Pricing.jsx

action_items: HIGH/CRITICAL — Fix /app/backend/auth.py get_current_user to reject role=='client' tokens (or accept only role in {'founder','admin'}). Otherwise a logged-in client can read /api/admin/clients (including all client emails) and call other admin endpoints. Suggested fix: `if payload.get('role') == 'client': raise HTTPException(403, 'Admin access required')` inside get_current_user, OR add a separate require_admin dependency.
LOW — Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to the Pricing CheckoutDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
USER CONFIG — Replace duplicated PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env with the real sandbox secret to unblock live PayPal OAuth (already documented).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py L50-60: get_current_user does not verify role; defaults missing role to 'founder' which silently elevates any token without a role claim. Combined with role='client' JWT being accepted, this is a privilege-escalation vector.

client_routes.py L420-446: my_orders/my_subscriptions calls request.app.state.agencyhandy.list_orders() with no client-scoping at AH side — it pulls ALL company orders then filters locally by email. OK for now but won't scale; consider AH server-side filter param.

paypal_routes.py L182-197: auto_provision_client_from_payment is wrapped in try/except Exception — silently swallows DB failure. Suggest at least adding a notification on failure so founder is alerted.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The 1 backend failure is a genuine security bug (role enforcement). All other PayPal + Client Portal endpoints work. Frontend selectors confirmed: pricing-plan-{key}-get-started-button, pricing-checkout-{key}-{name|email}-input, portal-profile-{name|company|phone}-input, portal-profile-save-button, portal-logout-button, footer-logo-admin-gate (5x click within 3s with 200ms gap navigates to /admin/login). PayPal Smart Buttons iframe loads even though OAuth fails because /api/paypal/config returns configured=true. Do NOT attempt full PayPal checkout — Client ID == Secret in .env.
rca_of_the_issue: Token role separation bug RCA: /app/backend/auth.py defines get_current_user which decodes JWT and returns email/name/role but does not validate role. /api/admin/* routes use Depends(get_current_user) which therefore accepts ANY valid signed JWT — including client tokens issued via /api/clients/login (role='client'). Reproduction: 1) POST /api/clients/login as testclient → get access_token. 2) GET /api/admin/clients with Bearer <token> → 200 OK returning entire clients list. Mitigation: enforce role whitelist in get_current_user, e.g. raise 403 if payload.role not in {'founder','admin'}.
